methodology.runtime: Fresh process and fresh isolated workspace per sample; alternating Node/Bun order; API-only direct createDaemon; deterministic unavailable adapter detection; all module imports included; ready and first authenticated compact snapshot measured from parent spawn; filesystem caches not flushed; RSS sampled immediately after first snapshot.
methodology.installs: Fresh manifest-only workspace per sample, original committed pnpm manifests/lock versus current Bun manifests/lock; one unmeasured warmup per manager; alternating order; normal trusted lifecycle scripts; frozen locks; existing global package/Electron caches; no node_modules reuse.
methodology.limitations: One local machine; wall-clock samples include subprocess/pipe scheduling; RSS is a point sample, not peak or long-duration memory; excludes Electron, Chromium startup and live runtime probes; install results do not establish GitHub-hosted CI speed.
